notes.title: 🎉 Official Release + New Feature: State Contracts Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]The moment has arrived — the game is officially [b]released[/b]![/p][p]After months of development, testing, and feedback from our incredible community, we’re excited to bring you version 1.5, packed with strategic depth, polished mechanics, and brand-new features.[/p][p][/p][p]🏗️ [b]New Feature: State Contracts[/b][/p][p]With the full release, we’re introducing a major gameplay addition: [b]State Contracts[/b].[/p][p]🔎 [b]How It Works[/b]
Players compete in [b]sealed-bid auctions[/b] — the lowest bidder wins the contract. Once assigned, [b]a portion of the winner’s assets is locked into the project[/b], making them temporarily unavailable on the open market.[/p][p]💼 [b]Why It Matters[/b]
State contracts offer [b]steady revenue[/b] and short-term advantages in key sectors.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning — we’ll continue to improve and expand based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]📢 [b]Download now and start building your financial empire![/b][/p]

notes.title: Game Update: Short Stock Operation Now Available!
notes.notes:
We’ve added a powerful new financial tool to your strategic arsenal: [b]Short Selling[/b].
With the Short Stock Operation, you can now sell shares you don’t own, aiming to repurchase them later at a lower price. It’s a calculated way to profit from overvalued stocks or anticipated declines in a company’s value.

Key Points:
[list]
[*]Profit from falling stock prices
[*]Target overvalued or weakening companies
[*]Adds new strategic depth and risk to market play
[/list]
Use it wisely. The market just became more dynamic and competitive.

💹 Update Now and Test Your Strategy

notes.title: Demo Game Update: New Financial Operations Now Available!
notes.notes:
Big moves are shaking up the market! In this latest update, we’ve added several powerful financial operations that give you even more strategic control over your companies. Here's what's new:

💰 [b]LBO (Leveraged BuyOut)[/b]
Take your company private by buying back public shares—especially smart when the stock is undervalued. But beware: increased debt can damage your credit rating.

💰 [b]Greenmail[/b]
Negotiate directly with major shareholders to buy out their stake. A costly but effective way to remove hostile investors and tighten your control.

💰 [b]Extraordinary Dividend[/b]
Distribute a one-time special dividend to shareholders. Great for rewarding investors—but watch your cash reserves and credit rating. And don’t forget: it’s taxable!

💰 [b]Stock Split[/b]
Split your company’s shares to improve market perception and liquidity. This is a cosmetic change—your total value stays the same, but it might attract new interest.

💰 [b]Restructure[/b]
Need fast cash? Sell off assets at a steep discount to stay afloat. A risky move, but sometimes necessary for survival.

Make your move wisely—every action has consequences. Jump back in and see how the market responds!

[b]💹 Update Now and Test Your Strategy[/b]

notes.title: Dev Week #19
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋 We’re back with another exciting update on our game. Our team has been hard at work to bring new features, fix bugs, and improve gameplay. Here’s what’s new this time!

🛠️ Bug Fixes
✅ Capital Gain Tax on Bank Stock Position – Fixed issues with tax calculations on bank stock positions.
✅ Price Chart X-Axis Date – Corrected the date display on the price chart for better accuracy.
✅ EPS News Component Bar Color – Fixed the color of the bar in the EPS news component to improve visibility.
✅ YTD Calculation – Resolved issues with the Year-to-Date (YTD) calculation.

🚀 New Features 
✅ Taxes Variation Logic – We’ve added more dynamic tax adjustments based on game progression and economic conditions.
✅ Central Bank Interest Variation Logic – Interest rates now fluctuate in response to changing economic factors, adding a new layer of strategy.
✅ GDP Growth Variation Logic – GDP growth now follows more realistic patterns, impacting overall game dynamics.
✅ GDP Growth Affects Customer Dynamics – As GDP grows or shrinks, the behavior and needs of customers will change, making market management even more challenging.
✅ CEO Wage Bonus & Wage & Skills – CEO wages, bonuses, and skills have been revamped to better align with company performance and economic trends.

🎮 Major Task: Politics & CEO The political landscape and the role of the CEO are getting a major update! Get ready for new political events that will influence your decisions, and a more in-depth CEO system that ties wages, bonuses, and skills to the company's performance and market conditions.

💡 What’s Next? The team is already looking ahead to the next set of updates! We’re working on even more features, improvements, and optimizations, so stay tuned for more exciting news. Don’t forget to drop your feedback in the comments — we love hearing from you!

Thanks for your continued support! 🚀🔥
